title: Geometric tower coordinates with normalized ordinary unit and tensor pullback
statement: For every prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, and morphism f:X→Y, there exist Base b and Geometry g for the actual quotient coefficient systems [def-sp-tower-shriek-data], a CoefficientPullback(g) [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal] whose adjoint is the unital constant direct-image map, and TensorPullback(g) [def-sfb-tower-class-tensor-pullback]. No root line, Chern data, twisting, or projective model is part of the conclusion.

source.place: clause (2), geometric unit and tensor constructions on actual towers

proof.text: Choose the normalized geometry and compatible finite unit comparisons from exists_unitLevelCoordinates. Apply systemIsoOfEvaluation_exists to assemble their hom maps into a coefficient-system isomorphism. Ordinary unit evaluation and naturality of ordinaryPushEvaluation identify the evaluated system adjoint with the finite adjoint after ordinaryPullEvaluation.inv. The finite normalization therefore proves CoefficientPullback.normalization.

Apply exists_tensorLevelCoordinates to the same geometry and its levelPushUnderlying normalization. Assemble each compatible family of finite tensor maps with systemIsoOfEvaluation_exists. Joint faithfulness of evaluations (proved by extensionality on sequence-site sections) turns finite naturality into naturality of the assembled maps. Package them with NatIso.ofComponents. Apply the same adjoint-evaluation identity to the assembled hom map; its evaluated hom is the supplied finite comparison, whose pure-tensor normalization is exactly TensorPullback.normalization.

proof_origin.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

    ∃ b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E, ∃ g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f,
      Nonempty (CoefficientPullback l E b f g) ∧ Nonempty (TensorPullback l E f g)
